A '''customs inspector''' served as a [[customs official]] at [[Whitestone City spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> he inspected a [[TL-1800 light freighter/Legends|TL-1800 freighter]] carrying members of the [[Hand of Judgment]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that had deserted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. After verifying their false identification documents and warning them not to cause trouble, he collected the standard docking fees along with additional [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from [[Daric LaRone]], the leader of the stormtroopers, who suspected that the inspector was using the credits to augment his salary.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The customs inspector appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
